column1: # The math vocabulary (plan P1-22; design T8 MathDict): one row per spelling,
# font-independent. tools/mathdict.py reads it with the pinned UCD and MathML
# Core files and generates engine/gen/math_dict.h, engine/src/math/atom.h and
#   name: the spelling (a word, an operator key, !word, AA..ZZ)
#   cp: the code point (0: a text operator, set in letters)
#   class: TeX atom class; flags: large limits textop
#   negation: the UCD precomposed negation (cp + U+0338), or -
#   alias_of: the row that owns this code point, or -
#   tex: the TeX spelling (converters only; filled by plan P3-24), or -
#   default_for_cp: y = the row a bare code point takes its class from
#   class_source: mathml (as MathML Core derives it) or override
